title: BlenDAgger: Blended Shared Control for Interactive Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policies are frequently trained from human corrections, yet teleoperating a robot to provide corrections is burdensome, and human demonstrators are not always optimal. We propose Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger), an approach for collecting data to train imitation learning policies by using shared control to blend the policy's and demonstrator's actions during interventions. By blending human and policy actions, we aim to improve the autonomous performance of manipulation policies. We validate our approach across five manipulation tasks, two in the real world and three in simulation. Our approach achieves higher autonomous performance by 30 or more percentage points on two real-world tasks compared to a typical human-gated correction approach (HG-DAgger). translated_title: BlenDAgger：面向交互式模仿学习的混合共享控制
translated_abstract: 机器人策略通常通过人工纠正来训练，然而通过遥操作机器人来提供纠正十分繁琐，且人类演示者也并非总是最优的。我们提出了混合DAgger（BlenDAgger），这是一种通过共享控制在人类干预期间将策略动作与演示者动作相混合来收集数据、以训练模仿学习策略的方法。通过混合人类与策略的动作，我们旨在提升操作策略的自主性能。我们在五个操作任务上验证了该方法，其中两个为真实世界任务，三个为仿真任务。与典型的由人类门控的纠正方法（HG-DAgger）相比，我们的方法在两个真实世界任务上的自主性能高出30个百分点以上。我们还研究了BlenDAgger能够实现更高自主性能的优势，发现BlenDAgger使策略控制与人工控制之间的切换平滑度提高了57%……
tldr: BlenDAgger提出一种混合共享控制方法，在人类干预时将策略动作与人类动作融合以收集训练数据，在真实世界操作任务上的自主性能比HG-DAgger高出30个百分点以上。
en_tdlr: BlenDAgger introduces blended shared control that fuses policy and human actions during interventions for data collection, achieving over 30 percentage points higher autonomous performance than HG-DAgger on real-world manipulation tasks.
